titel: The disability degree calculator has been switched off
untertitel: We no longer show a number here that we cannot stand behind.
warumText: The calculator added the individual values together. That is precisely what the German medical assessment principles rule out (Annex to § 2 VersMedV, Part A No. 3.2). What matters is how the impairments relate to one another: whether they reinforce each other, stand side by side independently, or overlap. That is a judgement about the individual case, not a formula.
warumHinweis: If you saw a number here in the past, please do not rely on it. It may have been far too high or far too low — and so were the benefits listed alongside it.
wohinTitel: Where to get a reliable answer
amtText: Only the pension office determines the degree of disability, on application and after reviewing the medical findings. The office responsible is the one where you live; depending on the federal state it is called Versorgungsamt, Amt für soziale Angelegenheiten or Landesamt.
verbandText: Social associations such as VdK and SoVD advise on the application and represent their members in objection and court proceedings. Advice usually requires membership.
antragText: You can still generate a letter for a first application to the pension office. It does not estimate a degree — it files the application.
stand: Switched off on 16 September 2026. Whether and when a professionally reviewed overall assessment returns is open.
